get.description: Retrieve all pipelines for a specified object type in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to access pipeline information without paging, making it useful for obtaining a complete list of pipelines associated with a particular object type.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of object for which pipelines are being retrieved. This is a required parameter and must be specified in the path.

post.description: Create a new pipeline for a specified object type in your HubSpot account. This endpoint requires a JSON request body with details about the pipeline, including its label, display order, and stages. The operation returns the newly created pipeline's details upon success.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of object for which the pipeline is being created, such as deals or tickets.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific pipeline in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to access the properties and stages of the pipeline identified by the given pipelineId and objectType. It is useful for obtaining the current configuration and status of a pipeline.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of object the pipeline is associated with, such as deals or tickets.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline to retrieve.

put.description: Update an existing pipeline in your HubSpot account by specifying the pipeline ID and object type. This operation allows you to modify the pipeline's properties, such as its label, display order, and stages. Ensure that the request body contains the necessary fields for a successful update.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of object the pipeline is associated with, such as deals or tickets.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline to update.

parameters.name: validateDealStageUsagesBeforeDelete
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether to validate deal stage usages before deleting. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: validateReferencesBeforeDelete
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether to validate references before deleting. Defaults to true.

delete.description: Delete a specific pipeline in your HubSpot account identified by its object type and pipeline ID. This operation can optionally validate references and deal stage usages before deletion to ensure data integrity.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of object the pipeline belongs to, such as deals or tickets.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline to delete.

parameters.name: validateDealStageUsagesBeforeDelete
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether to validate deal stage usages before deleting the pipeline. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: validateReferencesBeforeDelete
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether to validate references before deleting the pipeline. Defaults to true.

patch.description: Update an existing pipeline in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify specific properties of a pipeline, such as its label, display order, or archived status. Use this to keep your pipeline data up-to-date and organized.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of object associated with the pipeline, such as deals or tickets.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline to update.

parameters.name: validateDealStageUsagesBeforeDelete
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether to validate deal stage usages before deleting. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: validateReferencesBeforeDelete
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether to validate references before deleting. Defaults to true.

get.description: Retrieve audit logs for a specific pipeline in your HubSpot account. This endpoint provides detailed information about changes made to the specified pipeline, which can be useful for tracking modifications and understanding the history of the pipeline's configuration.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of object the pipeline is associated with, such as deals or tickets.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline for which audit logs are being retrieved.

get.description: Retrieve all stages for a specific pipeline within a given object type in your HubSpot account. This endpoint is useful for obtaining detailed information about each stage in a pipeline, which can be used for analysis or integration with other systems.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of object for which the pipeline stages are being retrieved, such as deals or tickets.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline whose stages are being retrieved.

post.description: Create a new stage within a specified pipeline for a given object type in HubSpot. This endpoint is useful for adding new stages to a pipeline, allowing for more granular tracking and management of objects through different stages of a process.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of object for which the pipeline stage is being created, such as deals or tickets.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline to which the new stage will be added.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific stage within a pipeline for a given object type in HubSpot. This endpoint is useful for accessing information about a particular stage, such as its label, display order, and metadata, which can be used for managing or analyzing pipeline stages.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of object for which the pipeline stage is being retrieved.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline that contains the stage.

parameters.name: stageId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the stage to retrieve within the pipeline.

put.description: Update a specific stage within a pipeline for a given object type in HubSpot. This endpoint allows you to modify the details of a stage, such as its label, display order, and metadata. Use this to keep your pipeline stages up-to-date and aligned with your business processes.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of object the pipeline belongs to, such as deals or tickets.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline containing the stage.

parameters.name: stageId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the stage to update.

delete.description: Delete a specific stage from a pipeline in your HubSpot account. This operation is useful for managing and maintaining your pipeline stages by removing those that are no longer needed. Ensure that any references to the stage are handled appropriately before deletion.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of object the pipeline belongs to, such as deals or tickets.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline from which the stage will be deleted.

parameters.name: stageId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the stage to delete.

parameters.name: validateReferencesBeforeDelete
parameters.description: A boolean flag indicating whether to validate references before deleting the stage. Defaults to true.

patch.description: Update a specific stage within a pipeline in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify the properties of an existing pipeline stage, such as its label, display order, and metadata. Use this to keep your pipeline stages up-to-date with your business processes.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of object that the pipeline belongs to, such as deals or tickets.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline that contains the stage to be updated.

parameters.name: stageId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the stage to update within the specified pipeline.

get.description: Retrieve the audit information for a specific stage within a pipeline in your HubSpot account. This endpoint provides details about actions taken on the specified stage, which can be useful for tracking changes and understanding the history of modifications.

parameters.name: objectType

parameters.name: stageId
